versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0

- Initial release of Home Food Planner.
- Provides weekly menu planning, ingredient management, shopping list generation, nutrition analysis, and recipe recommendations.
- Supports special diet planning and usage examples for different family needs.
- Includes ready-to-use meal plans and a recipe collection for quick reference.

- Added English translation for all documentation and descriptions, replacing previous Chinese content.
- Updated skill description and feature explanations to English for broader accessibility.
- Clarified example commands and usage scenarios in English.
- No changes to the underlying functionality; documentation only.
